periods.time: Second-day afternoon through C-block third-round match
periods.label: 染血达文西以画家灵魂挑战无冕剑王

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

periods.affiliation: Akatsuki Academy; Rebellion by transactional debt; Kazamatsuri family by adoption ties

status.current: loses the third round to Ikki but refuses to truly abandon her artistic obsession
status.condition: physically frail, dependent on prior surgery to move and paint; emotionally awakened by a serious duel
status.goal: complete her father's unfinished Armageddon painting using Ikki as the Messiah model

personality.summary: Monomaniacal, socially shameless and physically weak, yet sincerely devoted to art and capable of deep maternal gentleness.
values: repaying love to her father in her own one-sided way

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Desired model and third-round opponent; she bets her right to pursue him on victory, learns from his resistance, and later ignores the promise not to chase him again.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Ikki's lover and jealous protector; Stella restrains her, forces her to buy proper clothes and witnesses her maternal side.
relationships.nagi-arisuin: Stylist for the shopping trip; he recognizes she lacks Rebellion's foul malice and teaches her cosmetics/clothes.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Nominal sister through Kazamatsuri Kozo's guardianship; Rinna watches her match with Stella.
relationships.charlotte-corday: Rinna's maid, also observing the match from Akatsuki's side.
relationships.edelweiss: Model for Sara's strongest copy; Sara observed the real Edelweiss and paints a near-perfect but soulless phantom.
relationships.sara-father-mario-rosso: Her deceased father, a failed painter whose unfinished work becomes Sara's life purpose and whose face she gives to her final soul-image.

periods.summary: Sara continues stalking Ikki as the ideal nude model for the central Messiah in her father's unfinished painting. Stella catches her trying to undress Ikki in the infirmary, and Sara explains that completing the painting is as serious to her as the tournament is to knights. Because her apron tears, Stella and Ikki drag her shopping with Alice and Shizuku; Alice styles her into a deliberately sexy but secure outfit, and Sara explains she joined Rebellion only transactionally for surgery and travel access. At the lost-child center, she calmly comforts a teleporting infant by imitating nursing and singing an Italian lullaby, revealing unexpected maternal warmth. She later tells Ikki her childhood story: illness, a father who never turned away from his painting, hatred of art, then the decision to complete the painting as her only filial act and as a challenge to the heat of his art. In the third-round match she fights seriously for the first time, using Color of Magic, Necro Battalion, a copied Edelweiss, copied Ikkis and finally Mario Rosso, a giant bloodied swordsman that embodies her own artistic soul and bears her father's remembered face. Ikki defeats her, but she refuses to truly obey the condition to stop pursuing his model, because she is her stubborn father's daughter.

key_events.summary: Appears during the infirmary aftermath and gives early hints about Ikki's father problem.
Is styled by Alice and later reveals her father, illness and unfinished painting.
Comforts the lost teleporting infant with calm observation and an Italian lullaby.
Fights Ikki seriously with Fantasia Art and loses after exhausting her strongest images.
